elements.requirement: A person commits an offence if that person dishonestly, with a view to gain for himself or another or with intent to cause loss to another, destroys, defaces, conceals or falsifies any account or any record or document made or required for any accounting purpose.
elements.quote: destroys, defaces, conceals or falsifies any account or any record or document made or required for any accounting purpose

elements.requirement: A person commits an offence if that person dishonestly, with a view to gain for himself or another or with intent to cause loss to another, in furnishing information for any purpose produces or makes use of any account, or any such record or document made or required for an accounting purpose, which to his knowledge is or may be misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular.
elements.quote: in furnishing information for any purpose produces or makes use of any account, or any such record or document as aforesaid, which to his knowledge is or may be misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular

elements.requirement: A person who is convicted on indictment of an offence under subsection (1) is liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding seven years.
elements.quote: on conviction on indictment, be liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding seven years

elements.requirement: A person who makes or concurs in making in an account or other document an entry which is or may be misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular is to be treated as falsifying the account or document.
elements.quote: makes or concurs in making in an account or other document an entry which is or may be misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular

elements.requirement: A person who omits or concurs in omitting a material particular from an account or other document is to be treated as falsifying the account or document.
elements.quote: omits or concurs in omitting a material particular from an account or other document, is to be treated as falsifying the account or document

thresholds.what: maximum term of imprisonment on conviction on indictment
